task.title: Connect the Router
task.shortdesc: Connect the to the to provide network access to user devices.

prereq.p: Before you connect the router, make sure that you have:

ul.li: A working or Optical Network Terminal (ONT).
The power adapter provided in the box.

prereq.note: Make sure that the ISP has activated the Internet service.
Use only the power adapter supplied with the . An incompatible power adapter can damage the router.

context.p: The connects the home network to the Internet through the or ONT. The router provides wired and wireless network access to client devices.
context.note: Identify the before you connect the Ethernet cable. Do not connect the modem or ONT to a LAN port.
If the modem or ONT includes routing functions, refer to the ISP instructions for the correct operating mode. Two active routers can cause a double network address translation configuration.

step.cmd: Put the on a stable and open surface.

info.p: Make sure that air can move freely around the router. Keep the router away from heat sources, water, and enclosed spaces.

step.cmd: Turn off the or ONT and the .

info.note: If the ONT does not have a power switch, follow the instructions supplied by the ISP.

step.cmd: Connect the or ONT to the on the .

substep.cmd: Connect one end of an Ethernet cable to the on the or ONT.
Connect the other end of the Ethernet cable to the on the .

step.stepresult: The router has a physical connection to the modem or ONT.

info.p: Wait until the status indicators show that the Internet service is ready.
info.note: The startup process can take several minutes. Indicator names and colors can differ by device.

step.cmd: Connect the supplied power adapter to the and an electrical outlet.

info.p: If the router does not have a power button, the router starts when you connect the power adapter.

step.cmd: Wait until the router status indicators show that the router is ready.

info.p: Make sure that the power and WAN connection indicators show normal operation.

step.cmd: Connect a computer or mobile device to the .

choices.choice: For a wired connection, connect the computer to the by using an Ethernet cable.
For a wireless connection, connect the device to the default Wi-Fi network specified on the router label.

info.note: Use a wired connection for the initial configuration when possible. A wired connection is not affected when you change the Wi-Fi settings.

step.cmd: Check the status indicators on the .

info.p: Make sure that the router shows an active power connection and an active WAN connection.
info.note: If the WAN connection indicator does not show normal operation, make sure that the Ethernet cable is fully connected at both ends.

step.stepresult: The is connected to the or ONT.

result.p: The is connected to the or ONT. The router is ready for Wi-Fi configuration.

postreq.p: Configure the Wi-Fi network name, wireless security mode, and Wi-Fi password.
